religion_note: Membership of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in Denmark (Folkekirken) on 1 January 2026, as the Civil Registration System records it for every resident (Statistics Denmark, KM6): 1,113,571 members and 833,641 non-members, who together make the whole population on that day (FOLK1A 2026K1; the population shown here is of 1 July 2026 2026). A count of registered membership, not of belief. Denmark registers no other denomination, so the non-members -- people of other faiths and of none alike -- are one group.
language_basis: survey estimate: self-identification, residents aged 15 and over in private households
language_note: European Social Survey, ESS rounds 7, 9 (2014-2019), pooled: the language most often spoken at home, first mentioned (lnghom1); a language named by fewer than 5 respondents here is in Other languages. A survey estimate, not a count: 576 respondents in NUTS region DK01 gave an answer (5 refused, did not know or did not answer and are left out), weighted within each round by the post-stratification weight (pspwght), rescaled to that round's respondents here, and pooled. Universe: residents aged 15 and over in private households who could be interviewed in a survey language. Tabulated by the ESS Data Portal's open analysis service. The census does not ask home language here, or its figure is not published for this unit; a census or register count replaces this estimate wherever one is read.
median_age_note: Interpolated within the single year of age that holds the middle person, from Statistics Denmark, FOLK1A's count of residents by single year of age on 1 July 2026; the office tabulates the ages, not this median.
sex_ratio_note: Males per 100 females among residents on 1 July 2026 (957,772 males, 991,564 females).
ethnicity_note: Ancestry and country of origin on 1 July 2026, as the Civil Registration System records them (Statistics Denmark, FOLK1C): ANCESTRY, not ethnicity, which no Danish register records. 'Danish' is every person of Danish origin -- one parent at least a Danish citizen born in Denmark; immigrants and their descendants are counted under their country of origin, which for an immigrant is the country of birth and for a descendant the parents' country. 'Other' is every country holding fewer than 6,032 of the country's people (0.1%), and 'Not stated' a country the register does not know. Written by the map owner's decision of 19 September 2026.
